positions.title: Software Development Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Worked on the Encoding Team in Amazon Instant Video
Developed a program that detects and describes the characteristics of black bars embedded within video content across the entire video catalog
Modified and updated install scripts that perform silent installations of video encoders across all encoding hosts
Languages: Java, Spring, Python, SimpleWorkflow, Windows Batch File, Amazon Proprietary Tools

positions.title: Software Intern
positions.description:
Worked on the Remote Web Filtering Windows application, which filters HTTP/HTTPS URL requests on company computers outside of the primary network
Interfaced with the Windows API
Developed a feature that configures Windows Access Control Lists differently for Administrators and Users in order to protect sensitive files from unprivileged users
Fixed existing tickets/bugs and refactored code logic to be more extensible
Ran extensive quality assurance tests
Languages: C++, Perl, SQL

positions.title: Jr. Webmaster III
positions.description:
Maintained pre-existing HTML and JavaScript code
Routinely updated code with new product information
Developed a widget that shares items through social networks such as Facebook, Twitter, LinkedIn, and Email
Languages: JavaScript, PHP, Perl
Developed a directions service with Google Maps API v2 that displays a map and driving directions from any starting location to the UCSD Bookstore
Languages: JavaScript, HTML

honors.title: "Best Use of Login with Amazon" Winner of Seattle Startup Weekend 2013
honors.description:
Created a company named 'Matcha' that believes 'Being good should be fun!'.  We set out to make your kids love doing chores.

Created an app that tracks chores, rewards kids with money, and allows these kids to buy items from marketplaces such as Amazon.
honors.issuer: Issued by Seattle Startup Weekend · Aug 2013

honors.title: "Best Hack for Good" Winner of Yahoo Hack-U 2011
honors.description: Created an application that set out to be a more language intuitive search engine.  An engine that doesn't just retrieve 'information' but performs 'actions' on potentially any web-app on the internet.
